profile.name: Bhuwan Trivedi
profile.tagline: Building full-stack web projects while learning cloud computing, one commit at a time.
about: Hi, I'm Bhuwan — a BCA student at Poornima University, Jaipur, specializing in Cloud Computing, with hands-on experience in Python, PHP, MySQL, HTML, and CSS.
I completed a Full Stack Development internship at Cynbit Technologies, where I worked across the frontend and backend building real features rather than just following tutorials.
I've built responsive full-stack web projects with authentication and database integration, and I'm especially interested in cloud technologies and backend development.
Outside of coursework, I like exploring new tools, working through certifications, and building small projects to put what I'm learning into practice.

experience.title: Full Stack Development Intern
experience.description: Worked on full-stack web development, building and maintaining features across the frontend and backend as part of an internship program.

experience.title: BCA — Cloud Computing
experience.description: Coursework focused on cloud computing fundamentals, virtualization, and full-stack web development.

projects.title: Bike Rental Website
projects.description: A responsive bike rental platform with user authentication and booking management, an admin dashboard for managing users and bookings, and a MySQL database for storing customer and rental information.
